summary: Iteration 2 re-verification of 2 fixed HIGH bugs + previously-skipped cross-user referral commission test on PHP+MariaDB DYNOVA NETWORK app via FastAPI reverse-proxy. All 4 targeted tests PASS: (1) referral link now uses public domain, (2) star-N data-testids work and rating submission credits +Rs 50, (3) admin settings (L1 10->12) persists across reload, (4) L1 referral commission credits referrer +Rs 5 (10% of 50 PKR) and shows up in Recent Activity as 'L1 from UserB5'.

TEST_2_task_rating_submission.evidence: data-testid='star-5' present, label click toggles #s5 input.checked=true, submit-rating triggers flash 'Task submitted! +Rs 50.00 added to your wallet.'

TEST_3_settings_persistence.evidence: Logged in as admin@dynova.com, changed referral_l1 from 10 to 12 via settings-general-form. After reload of /api/?r=admin/settings, input retained value=12. Flash 'Settings updated.' shown. Restored back to 10 after test.

TEST_4_multi_level_commission.evidence: Signed up UserA5 (whatsapp 3069729380, ref DN72938061D). Logged out via /api/?r=auth/logout. Signed up UserB5 via /api/?r=auth/signup&ref=DN72938061D — hidden ref field auto-populated correctly. UserB5 submitted 1 task (+Rs 50). Logged back in as UserA5: dashboard shows TOTAL BALANCE Rs 5.00, TODAY'S EARNINGS Rs 5.00, Recent Activity entry 'Referral · L1 from UserB5  +Rs 5.00'. Commission = 10% of 50 = 5 PKR confirmed.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: page.context.clear_cookies() does not fully reset PHP session state through the FastAPI proxy — proper /api/?r=auth/logout endpoint should be used to switch users in tests. Not a product bug, just a testing note.

Minor: dashboard widget elements [data-testid='balance'], [data-testid='referral-earnings'], [data-testid='total-referrals'] return null from .innerText in headless contexts but render visually fine. Possibly nested SVG/span structure — consider exposing pure-text testid on the numeric value node for easier automated assertion.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@dynova.com / password. Test users created during run: UserA5 (3069729380/test1234) ref DN72938061D, UserB5 (3079729380/test1234) — both signed up via public signup endpoint.
seed_data_creation: Created several test users (UserA/UserB variants 4-5 with unique whatsapp numbers) and submitted 1 task per user. Admin L1 was temporarily changed to 12 then restored to 10.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 priority items from iteration 2 review request are verified working. The referral commission cross-user flow specifically requires using /api/?r=auth/logout (not page.context.clear_cookies) to switch users — clearing cookies through the FastAPI proxy seems to cause the next ?r=auth/signup&ref=... request to redirect to login. Captcha 'What is X + Y?' regex parses cleanly. Iteration 1 HIGH bug (referral link with 127.0.0.1) and nit (missing star-N testids) are both fixed and confirmed.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all previously-reported bugs have been verified as fixed.
